_comment: What example.project.json compiles to, resolved against example.definitions.json.
The DLC folder is always DLC_MOD_ModMaker - a ModMaker mod is a single DLC, and it is the name
the generator excludes from its own scans so a built mod never becomes its own baseline.
Everything is already resolved: inheritance applied, defaults filled in for struct members the
user did not touch, the {difficulty} dimension expanded to a concrete section, and each value
serialized to final config text. The compiler reads only this file.
- cooldowntime is written whole. The user set only BaseValue; Formula and the rank bonuses
come from bundle defaults, because config text has no partial structs.
- biodifficulty uses `replace`, not `value`. Overriding an array entry is a type-4 subtraction
of the EXACT shipped text followed by a type-3 re-add. If `remove` is off by so much as a
trailing 'f' the subtraction silently fails and the game sees both entries.

mod.name: Silver Grind
mod.author: Mgamerz
mod.description: Slower, heavier Silver. Pull actually does something.
